title: Show that the canonical word payload omits the gauge annihilator
body:
## Summary
- The paired-cube word container is built from keys that do not start with `_`. The gauge annihilator is stored as `_gauge_ann` and then dropped.
- Two words with the same public gauges and annihilators `[3]` and `[4]` decompress to the same payload. A changed public gauge dimension does not. A changed gzip modification time changes the container hash only.
- No producer edit and no new exponent.

## Test plan
- [x] `python3.12 -B research/canonical-gauge-field/verify.py`
- [x] `python3.12 -B research/canonical-gauge-field/test_verify.py`
